title: fix(plugin-form): report collapsible / collapsed beside group only when true
body:
Fixes #25955

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

`@object-ui/plugin-form`'s `reportGroupOwnedKeys` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionGroups.ts`) no longer reports `collapsible` / `collapsed` on a `{ group }` form section unless they are `true`. `name`, `label`, `description` and `visibleWhen` are still reported on any value, and a `true` beside `group` (a programmatic SDUI caller that skips the spec's parse) is still reported.

## Why

`FormSectionSchema` in `@objectstack/spec` gives both keys `.default(false)`, so every parsed section carries `collapsible: false, collapsed: false`, and its group refinement lists them under `trueOnlyDerivedKeys`: only `true` is refused beside `group`. The renderer filtered `GROUP_OWNED_SECTION_KEYS` by "is not `undefined`", so every `{ group }` section of every parsed form logged "also declares `collapsible`, `collapsed`" and told the author to move keys they never wrote (HotCRM contact and opportunity pages, as the card measured).

Per the triage ruling (comment 6409254426) the fix is in the renderer, not the spec: the spec's `default(false)` stays and no protocol changes.

## How the two lists stay in agreement

The spec passes its true-only list inline to `sectionGroupReferenceRefinement` and exports no name for it, so the renderer cannot import it. The renderer keeps a private two-key set, `TRUE_ONLY_GROUP_OWNED_SECTION_KEYS`, and the new test measures agreement by parse instead of copying the list a third time: for every key in `GROUP_OWNED_SECTION_KEYS`, at `false` and at `true` (and at a string for the non-boolean keys), the warning names the key exactly when `FormSectionSchema.safeParse` refuses that key with a `custom` issue at that path. If the spec ever moves a key between `derivedKeys` and `trueOnlyDerivedKeys`, that leg goes red. The new set is not exported, so the package entry surface pinned by `sectionGroupResolverPublished-8641.test.ts` is unchanged.

## Files

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionGroups.ts`: the true-only set, a `restatesGroupOwnedKey` predicate, and `reportGroupOwnedKeys` filtering through it.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/sectionGroupTrueOnlyKeys-25955.test.ts` (new, `unit` project): a parsed `{ group, columns }` section warns nothing; a parsed explicit `false` pair warns nothing; `{ group, collapsed: true }` warns naming only `collapsed`; `true` beside a `false` names only the `true` key; `label` still warns; and the per-key agreement with the spec described above.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: re-recorded with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (registry source digest only; `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-unchanged).
- `.changeset/25955-group-section-true-only.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch.
